result.summary: The page is mostly well-structured, but there is one clear visual defect: overlapping metadata text under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card. A minor styling inconsistency in the favorite (heart) buttons is also present. Carousel edge clipping and bottom viewport cutoff were treated as intended behavior and excluded.

issues.description: Under the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card, the delivery time and delivery fee strings overlap, rendering as garbled text ('25–3€0 delivery' / '35 min' superimposed). Two text elements appear to be absolutely positioned or stacked in the same space instead of flowing inline.
issues.suggestion: Place the metadata items (time, delivery fee, cuisine) in a single flex row with proper spacing and a separator dot, ensuring no absolute positioning causes overlap. Verify text does not collide at any viewport width.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button on the first restaurant card (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) has no visible background container, while the second card's heart sits on a dark circular scrim. This inconsistency makes the first icon harder to see against light imagery and looks unfinished.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same semi-transparent dark circular background to all favorite buttons for consistent contrast and appearance across cards.
